note: The world's own treasure: where each setting item turns up and who wants it, rules for items the archive gave none (HOMEBREW), and where each artifact rests with the leads that point to it. Shown on each record's page (GM only) and used by the Treasure tool. Archive records are never changed.

ITM-001.where: On the hands of the dead at the Cairn of the Forgotten, and in Lantern House mortuaries.
ITM-001.wants: Sister Elyra Vale [NPC-006], who must record it for the Order.

ITM-002.where: Sold by Illa Reed at the Market of Lost Things, or found on Pact informers.
ITM-002.wants: Vess the Grey [NPC-008]: the Pact pays well for eyes that see yesterday.

ITM-003.where: Lantern House mortuaries and the graves of Order undead-hunters.
ITM-003.wants: The Lantern House, which lost three.

ITM-004.where: Given between Wildborn bond-mates, and lost on battlefields when one of them dies.
ITM-004.wants: Whoever is still bound to the other end.

ITM-005.where: The Sunken Archive and Consortium vaults.
ITM-005.wants: Archivist Lissara Wynne [NPC-035], and anyone with something they need never forgotten.

ITM-006.where: Consortium survey teams, and scavengers on the Bloodmarked Fields.

ITM-007.where: Shard-sites, where crystal splinters after a shard surfaces.
ITM-007.wants: Captain Marrek Vaal [NPC-005], for the Shard of Dominion.

ITM-008.where: Aether Scars, and the Bloodmarked Fields.
ITM-008.wants: The Celestial Order, to destroy it. The Consortium, to study it.

ITM-009.where: Order chapels in the Purged Halls, and the Lantern House's bell-tower.
ITM-009.wants: The Celestial Order, which uses it to find heretics, and the Veilborn, who want it silenced.

ITM-010.where: Legion bloodline-keepers in Varkhaal; Pact genealogists in Noctis.
ITM-010.wants: Anyone opening a bloodlock, and every house with a secret ancestor.

ITM-011.where: Gamblers in Noctis, and Consortium time-labs.
ITM-011.wants: Any Pact gambler who has lost one, and will say it was stolen.

ITM-012.where: Legion siege companies, and shard-sites after a shard has been taken.

ITM-013.where: Consortium surveyors, and Wildborn trackers who took it from them.

ITM-014.where: Old Vara's forge; the Veilborn Archive.
ITM-014.wants: Sera Noll [NPC-012], for finding people with impossible memories.

ITM-015.where: Refugees who came out of the Hollow Verge, and the Nameless Asylum's Lost Shelf.
ITM-015.wants: Anyone looking for the way in, and Tessk the Wayfinder [NPC-372], who'd rather nobody found it.

ITM-016.where: The Repository of the Unwritten; the Fields of Lost Realities.
ITM-016.wants: The Arcane Consortium, and the Architects of Eternity [FAC-502].

ITM-017.where: The Midnight Court's hall of mirrors; the Silent Archive.
ITM-017.wants: Every Thinning victim, and the Veilborn [FAC-503].

ITM-018.wants: Archmagister Veylan Orithis [NPC-034], who made it and lost it.

ITM-019.where: Nightglass, and the Pact's best infiltrators.

ITM-020.where: The Citadel of the Hidden, or the Forgotten One's keeping. Never in an ordinary hoard.

ITM-021.where: The Loom of Eternity, among the thread-grues.
ITM-021.wants: The Hidden Ones, the Cycle Breakers, and Vyrithar [NPC-002].

ITM-022.where: The Loom of Eternity, kept by Vyrithar's servants.
ITM-022.wants: Everyone who has lost someone to erasure.

ITM-301.rules: While lit, it sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for 10 feet more. It goes dark for 1 minute whenever a creature in its light knowingly tells a lie that you can hear.
ITM-301.where: Kaelholm tribunals, and the houses of honest traders.

ITM-302.rules: Once per dawn, as a Magic action, speak into it. Roll a d20: on 15 or higher, someone or something answers, and you can speak with it for up to 1 minute. The GM decides who: another stone's holder somewhere in Kaelmar, or something under the under-roads.
ITM-302.where: Kaelith ruins in the Deepwood and the Bloom Country.
ITM-302.wants: The Wrights, who think they know where its partner is.

ITM-303.rules: Set on Bloom-grown ground and spend 10 minutes listening. Make a DC 12 Wisdom (Perception) check: on a success, you learn roughly what has passed within a mile in the last day (kinds and numbers of creatures, and which way they went).
ITM-303.where: The Bloom-Speakers' sanctuary; Spore Circle groves.
ITM-303.wants: Tevan Lin [NPC-305], who'd teach the party to use it properly.

ITM-304.rules: Held, it replays its afternoon, sound and all, for 1 minute. Once ever, when you would gain a Thinning level, the crystal can take it instead; it goes clear and dark for good.
ITM-304.where: Kaelith ruins; the memory-house trades them.

ITM-305.rules: Set in a room for 1 hour, it works as the Alarm spell (audible to you) for 8 hours. Each time it triggers, roll a d20: on a 1 to 3, something from the between hears it too.
ITM-305.where: Old Kaelith houses, in sets of four, usually with one cracked.
ITM-305.wants: The Boundary Keepers, who want it mended or buried.

ITM-306.rules: Set on an under-road, it slides toward the nearest vault at a riding horse's pace, carrying up to 500 pounds, including a rider. Off the under-roads, it only points.

ITM-307.rules: While you wear it, you have Advantage on saves against spores and the Spore-storm, and the Bloom can't read your mood or intentions.
ITM-307.where: Ashvale's Wrights make them; Spore Circle druids burn them.
ITM-307.wants: The Eastern Tendril, who want them gone.

ITM-308.rules: A glyph-lance: a +1 heavy crossbow that deals force damage instead of piercing and needs no bolts. It holds 3 charges of glyph-light and regains them when you spend a spell slot of level 1 or higher on it; spend a charge to add 2d6 force damage to a hit.
ITM-308.wants: The Scholar Corps, which counts its lances, and the thirteenth mark's family.

ITM-309.rules: Single use. When you fail a Thinning save, you succeed instead, and the thread snaps.
ITM-309.where: Tied by mothers in Ashvale and the nine settlements; traded at the Nameless Asylum.

ITM-310.rules: Single use. It opens one glass door without the Thinning save, then shatters.
ITM-310.where: The seeps' edges, and Kaelholm's confiscation vaults.
ITM-310.wants: Kaelholm, which forbids them, and everyone who wants through a glass door.

ITM-311.rules: Placed in a dormant or destroyed walker, it wakes as an ally (Animated Armor) and goes back to its old work: guarding, carrying, building. Redirecting it takes a DC 13 Intelligence (Arcana) check. It runs for 1 day per charge of glyph-light it's given.
ITM-311.where: Walker stables in Cradlehorn and the eastern ruins.

ITM-312.rules: A loaf of seven slices. One slice is a day's food and water. If you eat more than three slices in a week, make a DC 10 Wisdom save: on a failure, you hear the Bloom for a day, which is distracting (Disadvantage on Concentration saves).
ITM-312.where: Baked by Bloom-Speakers, and sold in Ashvale's market.

ART-001.rules: A shield granting +3 to AC. When a creature you can see hits you, use your Reaction to halve the damage; the shield stores it, and your next weapon hit before the end of your next turn deals extra force damage equal to what was stored. The cost: each dawn, make a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, a fallen warrior's memory takes you for an hour, and you fight their last battle instead of yours.
ART-001.holder: Set above the altar of the Sanctuary of the Last Light, guarded by keepers who won't let it leave.
leads: An Order pilgrim swears the shield at the Sanctuary moved in its brackets during the last siege.
Sister Elyra Vale has orders to report anyone who asks about the Aegis.
The keepers say the shield chooses who carries it out, and it has never chosen.

ART-002.rules: Your Strength is 25 while you wear them, and your unarmed strikes and weapons deal double damage to objects and structures. The cost: whenever you are Bloodied, make a DC 15 Wisdom save or attack the nearest creature, friend or foe, until it's down or you are.
ART-002.holder: On the hands of the dead warlord in the Warlord's Rest, whose tomb the Legion guards.
leads: The Legion lets no one into the Warlord's Rest, except champions of the Great Arena.
A Legion gravedigger says the warlord's hands have moved.

ART-003.rules: As a Bonus action, become invisible until you attack or cast a spell; creatures who don't see you for a minute forget they ever met you. The cost: each time you use it, make a Thinning save.
ART-003.holder: Hung on one of the stone masks of the Veilborn Archive, where nobody has noticed it in a long time.
leads: The Pact's histories mention Veylis, and then stop, mid-sentence.
A mask in the Veilborn Archive wears a cloak, and the archivists don't remember hanging it there.

ART-004.rules: A greatsword that deals an extra 2d10 slashing damage, ignores resistance, and cuts through stone and metal as if it were wood. Requires Strength 19 to wield; without it, you have Disadvantage on attacks with it, and a miss by 5 or more drops it.
ART-004.holder: Still lodged in the god-bone at the Titan's Fall, where grave-robbers have failed to free it.
leads: God-bone carvers in Kaelholm talk about a fang nobody could pull from the skeleton.
Titan-King Varuun of the Titans of the Rift wants it brought to the Colosseum of Echoes.

ART-005.rules: Once per dawn, cast Legend Lore, Scrying or Divination through it, without components. The cost: after each use, a DC 16 Wisdom save; on a failure, for a day you can't tell what you see from what you saw.
ART-005.holder: In the Sunken Archive's drowned reading room, watched by the Eye Beast.
leads: The Blind Seer asked for a book from the Sunken Archive. It isn't the book he wants.
Scavengers say the Eye Beast guards one eye of its own, under glass.

ART-006.rules: Once per dawn, cast Command, Mass Suggestion or Dominate Person through it (save DC 18). The cost: each use deals 3d10 necrotic damage to you that can't be healed until your next long rest, and removing the crown needs Remove Curse.
ART-006.holder: On the Shattered Throne, where the last king who wore it still sits.
leads: Nobody who climbs the steps of the Shattered Throne comes down without being told to.
The Legion and the Pact both have expeditions planned. Neither has come back.

ART-007.rules: Breathe water, swim at twice your speed, and once per dawn cast Control Water, Control Weather or Tsunami through it. The cost: it hungers. While you carry it, you can't sleep more than four hours a night, and it pulls you toward the sea.
ART-007.holder: Somewhere in the Abyssal Hollow, beating. Its other half is under the Black Tides.
leads: Drowned Saints sing about half a heart.
The ghost fleet rising from the Abyssal Hollow is looking for something.

ART-008.rules: A +3 dagger. On a hit, instead of dealing damage, you can force a DC 19 Charisma save: on a failure, the target's future is cut, and it can't benefit from Inspiration, luck or divination, and fate turns against it (Disadvantage on Death Saving Throws). The cost: after each such use, you make a Thinning save.
ART-008.holder: Sealed in the Repository of the Unwritten, in the Fractured Nexus.
leads: The Consortium's forbidden vault has one room no Consortium mage is allowed into.
A Hidden Warden has been seen near the Repository, waiting.

ART-009.rules: You don't age, and when you would drop to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 instead, once per dawn. You resist fire damage. The cost: each month, lose one memory of the player's choosing; when you have none worth keeping, you become fire.
ART-009.holder: Burning at the heart of the Crucible of Renewal.
leads: The Ashen Choir sings of an ember that can't go out.
Hadrek the Emberborn claims his name from a fire he once touched.

ART-010.rules: Weigh anything on it to learn its true worth: what an object is worth and to whom, whether a person is telling the truth about what they value, what a choice will cost. The cost: whoever is weighed knows, and what has been weighed can't be unweighed.
ART-010.holder: At the Midnight Court in Noctis, where it settles the Court's disputes.
leads: The Midnight Court never argues, because it weighs.
The Shadow Pact would trade the Scale for nothing. The Order would trade a city for it.

ART-301.rules: Scrape a name from any record, roll or memory-crystal, and it vanishes from every copy. The cost: each use, one person who knows you forgets your name.
ART-301.holder: The Rasp in Kaelholm keeps one under glass, and it's a copy. Where the real one is, nobody has written down.
leads: Burned names don't come back. Except once, long ago, and Kaelholm never says how.
The copy under glass in the Rasp is too clean for a knife that's done what this one has.

ART-302.rules: Once, commune with the Bloom as deeply as you like, learning anything it knows, and come back whole, with no Thinning save. The cost: afterwards, in any grove, the Bloom calls you by name.
ART-302.holder: Taken by the Eastern Tendril from a Speaker it caught, and kept at Thornhaven to be burned. It hasn't been.
leads: Tevan Lin knows it exists, and is afraid to ask who has it.
A Spore Circle druid at Thornhaven wears copper on her wrist and won't say why.

ART-303.rules: Read any glyph, living or dead, including the ones cut into people, and understand any writing in the First Grammar. The cost: after a week of use, you see glyphs on everyone and can't stop reading them (Disadvantage on Wisdom saves against being charmed or frightened, from the noise).
ART-303.holder: Lost with the repair crew in Arborhold in 22 AB.
leads: The Roll of the Lost Crew names who carried it.
Kaelholm's records say the Glass came out of Arborhold. They're wrong.

ART-304.rules: A Kaelith construct that wears it, or that hears its bells, obeys your commands (no save for walkers and vault-wards; a Guardian can make a DC 18 Wisdom save). The cost: the construct remembers being commanded, and so do its makers, wherever they are.
ART-304.holder: In Cradlehorn's walker stable, on a walker that no longer exists.
leads: The Wrights would trade almost anything for it. So would the Ascendancy.
There's a stall in Cradlehorn with a harness hook and no walker.

ART-305.rules: Anything Kaelith-made that you touch crumbles to ash (an action, or automatically on a hit against a construct: 6d10 force damage). The cost: each dawn, make a DC 15 Wisdom save or spend the day wanting to touch everything Kaelith you can see.
ART-305.holder: Worn by Elder Sorrel [NPC-307] of the Eastern Tendril, at Thornhaven.
leads: Elder Sorrel never takes off her circlet of charred root.
The Tendril's first leader is buried without her crown.

ART-306.rules: Look into it to see the world as it would be in the harmony. The vision is true, and it shows you one answer you need, once per look. The cost: each look is a level of Thinning, and you want to look again (DC 13 Wisdom save to resist when it's near).
ART-306.holder: One is in Kaelholm's confiscation vault since 297 AB. At least one more is out there.
leads: Kaelholm confiscated a mirror in 297 AB. The owner said, "There are others."
People in Low Fenn have been coming home Thinner, and happy about it.

ART-307.rules: Plant it and it grows overnight into a living house with rooms, doors and a hearth that never needs wood (Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion, permanent and real). The cost: the house has opinions, and acts on them.
ART-307.holder: The Bloom-Speakers planted one in Ashvale. It's their meeting house, and it likes Tevan. More seeds may be in Arborhold.
leads: The Bloom-Speakers' meeting house wasn't built. It grew.
Arborhold's records count seven seeds.

ART-308.rules: Sung at standing stones, its verses put to sleep or calm anything sleeping within a mile (as Sleep and Calm Emotions, no save for creatures already asleep). The cost: once you start singing, you can't stop until the song is done: 1d4 hours.
ART-308.holder: In Orla Hesk's keeping, in Ashvale. The missing verse is in her head.
leads: Orla carries an iron-bound book she never opens in public.
Every Ritekeeper reads one thing on taking office. It isn't the Hymnal.

ART-309.rules: It always reaches the bottom of anything: a pit, a well, the Rift. Climbing it is always safe. The cost: whoever climbs it back up loses something (a memory, a word, a fear), chosen by the GM.
ART-309.holder: Maro Grane [NPC-310] keeps it. He won't lend it, and won't say what he lost.
leads: Maro Grane went down into the Rift and came back.
Ask Maro what he's afraid of. He doesn't know any more.

ART-310.rules: Read a name aloud from it and gain that person's last memory. The cost: you keep the memory, and lose one of your own to make room.
ART-310.holder: The Tulls keep it in a locked drawer in Kaelholm. One name on it is a Tull's.
leads: The Tulls never talk about the repair crew of 22 AB.
One name on the Roll has been scraped out, and the First Rasp was used to do it.
